zh: 共享对话删除体验与一致性优化：非发起者删除对话自动退出共享并同步移除侧栏共享条目（不影响发起者）；发起者删除原对话时确认并收回成员共享副本。
修复模型按小写表名查询 ReportSnapshots / ReportMetricData 时因大小写敏感导致的报错，数据库工具现支持按实际表名大小写无关解析。
优化 tool_search 对「所有可用工具」等总览查询及无匹配关键词的处理，改为直接返回已挂载与按需工具目录摘要，不再误标红报错。
en: Aligned shared conversation deletion semantics: non-owner deletion cleanly leaves the share and removes the sidebar entry immediately, while owner deletion closes sharing and revokes member copies.
Resolved case-insensitive SQLite table names (such as ReportSnapshots / ReportMetricData) in database tools and updated default prompt references to avoid spurious schema errors.
Improved tool_search handling for catalog overview queries and zero-hit keyword searches so they return available tool summaries without false red error indicators.
